description: Look up the applicant tracking system (ATS) a specific large employer uses, from ResumeAI's State of ATS 2026 dataset (738 Fortune 500 / Global 2000 employers). Workday runs 48.2% of 421 re-verified large employers (October 2026 refresh). The verified sample skews toward vendors with public job APIs. Accepts a company name or slug, e.g. 'Nike' or 'jpmorgan-chase'.
name: which_ats
title: Which ATS does a company use?
